title: Listings Rate Card — Nightly Rate Range and Fee Maximums by Space Type
content:
# Rate Card: Nightly Rate Range and Fee Maximums

*Pricing team — the price figures each space type of Roamhaven Listings carries. All amounts are in US dollars.*

| Space type | Nightly-rate minimum | Nightly-rate maximum | Cleaning-fee maximum (per stay) | Short-stay cleaning fee allowed | Short-stay night limit | Pet-fee maximum (per stay) | Extra-guest fee maximum (per extra guest, per night) | Lowest extra-guest threshold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shared Room | $10.00 | $25000.00 | $150.00 | yes | 2 nights | $100.00 | $50.00 | 1 guest |
| Private Room | $10.00 | $25000.00 | $200.00 | yes | 2 nights | $150.00 | $75.00 | 1 guest |
| Entire Guest Suite | $10.00 | $25000.00 | $300.00 | yes | 2 nights | $300.00 | $150.00 | 1 guest |
| Entire Apartment | $10.00 | $25000.00 | $500.00 | yes | 2 nights | $300.00 | $150.00 | 1 guest |
| Entire Home | $10.00 | $25000.00 | $750.00 | yes | 2 nights | $300.00 | $300.00 | 1 guest |
| Luxury Villa | $300.00 | $25000.00 | $2500.00 | no | 0 (not allowed) | $500.00 | $500.00 | 1 guest |

## Definitions used on this card

- **Nightly-rate minimum and maximum** — the lowest and the highest nightly rate the host may set for a listing of the space type.
- **Cleaning-fee maximum** — the cleaning-fee figure of the space type, a per-stay amount.
- **Short-stay cleaning fee allowed** — whether the host may set a lower cleaning fee for short stays.
- **Short-stay night limit** — the longest stay, in nights, that is charged the short-stay cleaning fee; 0 where a short-stay cleaning fee is not allowed.
- **Pet-fee maximum** — the pet-fee figure of the space type, a per-stay amount.
- **Extra-guest fee maximum** — the extra-guest fee figure of the space type, charged per extra guest per night.
- **Lowest extra-guest threshold** — the lowest guest count from which the host may start charging the extra-guest fee; the fee applies to each guest beyond the threshold.

## Which stays a change reaches

For every space type, a change to a fee or to the nightly rate affects **stays booked after the change is saved**.

## Reading examples (hypothetical listings)

- A Luxury Villa listing priced at $280.00 a night is below the Luxury Villa nightly-rate minimum of $300.00; an Entire Home at $280.00 is within the Entire Home range of $10.00 to $25000.00.
- A Private Room stay of 2 nights falls within the short-stay night limit of 2 nights; a 3-night stay does not.
- A Luxury Villa carries no short-stay cleaning fee, because its space type does not allow one and its short-stay night limit is 0.
